newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures end quiet day mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures end quiet day mostly lower.

text.p: Feb 14 - U.S. stock index futures ended mostly lower after a very quiet session, with March S&P 500s plagued by light profit-taking from a recent series of record highs. Trading pits were thin as players took to the sidelines before the long holiday weekend. Trading will be suspended on Monday in observance of the U.S. Presidents Day holiday.
